subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this draft remain blocked until canonical iMessage normalization plus after-fix live iMessage proof are added, or should maintainers intentionally override the proof and identity-boundary risk?
rationale: The branch rewrites the identity used for authorization and delivery, the current proof is pre-fix only, and the author says the root issue may still remain, so accepting source-only evidence would be a maintainer-owned risk decision.

options.title: Hold For Normalization And Proof
options.body: Require canonical handle comparison, focused regression coverage, and redacted after-fix live iMessage logs or screenshots before this PR can merge.

options.title: Override Source-Only Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the remaining live-payload and identity-selection risk, but that would bypass the normal external-PR proof gate.

options.title: Pause Or Close This Draft Later
options.body: If the branch stays draft and the root cause remains unclear after the proof window, close or replace it with a narrower repair PR.

recommendation.title: Hold For Normalization And Proof
recommendation.body: Require canonical handle comparison, focused regression coverage, and redacted after-fix live iMessage logs or screenshots before this PR can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows Peter Steinberger touching the exact iMessage repair, inbound-processing, and normalization files, making this the best available routing candidate for the proof/identity-boundary choice.
